text:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION PAUSED: v2.14.1 -> canary. Pipeline 'release-candidate' failed at step 'integration-smoke' (runner: bk-eu-3).
Aisha: saw failing smoke, looks like a test hit a 504 when pulling artifact from registry mirror.
Rafael: can you paste the artifact verify logs?
Aisha: snippet:
```
[09:58:21Z] VERIFY: fetching s3://artifacts/release/v2.14.1/app.tar.gz
[09:58:22Z] ERROR: connection reset by peer during download
[09:58:22Z] RETRY: attempt 1
[09:58:28Z] ERROR: downloaded 1048575 bytes but expected 1048576 bytes
[09:58:28Z] FAIL: artifact verification mismatch
```
Theo: downloaded off-by-one again. We had a streaming truncation bug in mirror sync last month but thought it was fixed.
infra-oncall: I'm watching the mirror, I also see a truncated object in eu-west mirror at the same key. Checking backend logs.
Rafael: another complication: the pipeline ran in eu region but the canary is staged in ap-south. Deploybot verifies via the staging index which points to the nearest mirror. Cross-region propagation TTL might be 30s and the CI started right after publish.
Aisha: so two possible causes: 1) a transient mirror truncation during upload, or 2) inconsistent manifest size due to gzip metadata header differences from the packer step.
Theo: if it's a mirror transient we can re-trigger a mirror sync for that object. If it's a build stream issue we should re-publish the artifact from the buildkite cache.
Rafael: change window is still open but we should avoid rollback unless necessary. Options: a) re-sync mirror and re-run verification, b) re-publish artifact + re-run integrate, c) abort canary and cut hotfix.
Aisha: leaning to re-publish. I'll run `./scripts/publish_artifacts --build 20260323-rc1 --force --regions eu,ap` and then re-trigger integrate.
infra-oncall: started mirror re-sync job for key `v2.14.1/app.tar.gz`, watching checksum. If re-sync yields same truncated size, proceed with re-publish.
Rafael: please also tag the release with `hold:artifact-truncate` so deploybot doesn't auto-retry.
deploy-bot: Annotated v2.14.1 with `hold:artifact-truncate`. Manual intervention required to resume.
infra-oncall: mirror re-sync completed, returned full object (size 1048576) and checksums match.
Aisha: awesome — re-triggering integrate now.
Rafael: integrate passed on re-run. No need for rollback. Resume promotion when ready.
deploy-bot: Promotion resumed for v2.14.1 -> canary after manual confirmation.
Theo: follow-ups: 1) add a small pre-check in integration-smoke to validate artifact size/sha from the mirror before unpack, 2) add logs to registry mirror to detect streaming truncates and alert earlier.
Aisha: filing infra ticket and a tiny CI guard PR. Will add release note: "mitigation: transient registry mirror streaming truncate caused artifact verification failure; re-published artifact and re-triggered integration; no rollback."
Rafael: thanks all. Keeping an eye on canary metrics for the next hour.
